healthCheckStatus.mitigation: expertQuery default changed to a self-refreshing 'publication-date >= today(-14) AND classification-cpv = 72*' window (TED's server-side today([+-]N) function, live-verified), reducing matched notices from 42,134 to 2,332
healthCheckStatus.rootCause: Apify Cloud network-path latency to api.ted.europa.eu, not actor code or TED server performance
healthCheckStatus.guaranteeCaveat: Reduces but does not guarantee sub-300s completion; a single retried fetch() attempt has been observed taking 60-150+ seconds and tedClient.ts has no per-attempt timeout

testCoverage.note: Vitest suite under tests/ (deltaEngine, tedClient, routes, state, main, webhookNotifier) covering canonicalization/fingerprinting/classify state machine, real-shaped mocked TED HTTP responses including retry/backoff and error classification, INCREMENTAL/VALIDATE_QUERY/BACKFILL orchestration and PPE event billing, KV-store state round-tripping, and shutdown-safety wiring. All 143 tests pass; measured with @vitest/coverage-v8.

knownRisks: No per-attempt HTTP timeout in src/tedClient.ts (identified, not implemented — a candidate future hardening)

constraintCompliance.inviolableConstraint: Core extraction/classification logic (src/deltaEngine.ts) and PPE pricing were not altered when this repo was assembled or during the prior latency-mitigation audit.
constraintCompliance.verificationMethod: Independent adversarial re-read plus file-mtime cross-check (no git history existed in the source directory at time of audit)
